operational_pain.finding: The whole package business runs through a phone line and nothing else. Packages are the highest-value bundle they sell, cruise plus one of their own two hotels plus rail or motorcoach, and there is no online path to buy one.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Packages are available to book by phone only unless noted in the package description. Discounts are valid on new reservations only. All discounts must be booked directly with Major Marine Tours, and are not valid through third-party reservations or travel agencies.

operational_pain.finding: That phone line is open 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., seven days, year-round. Their first cruise of the day departs at 8:00 a.m. and their published check-in rule puts guests on the dock at 7:00 a.m., a full hour before anyone can answer a phone. Their last cruise returns at 7:00 p.m., an hour after the line closes.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Customer Service Hours: 8:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m. 7 days a week
operational_pain.confidence: fact for the hours and the departure times, INFERENCE for the gap

operational_pain.finding: Their own published check-in rule is impossible to obey for a major inbound flow. They require check-in one hour before departure, and they simultaneously sell the 11:30 am cruise as the connection off a train that arrives at 11:15 am. Guests arriving by rail have fifteen minutes, not sixty.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Please check in one hour prior to your cruise departure time for all cruises*
operational_pain.confidence: fact for both statements. The train timing is on the same site: 'The train arrives in Seward at 11:15 a.m. and the cruise departs at 11:30 a.m.' https://majormarine.com/faq/

operational_pain.finding: The contingency for a late train is manual, discretionary and unpromised. Every late arrival becomes a human judgment call about moving a party to another date or downgrading them to a shorter, cheaper cruise, which means a partial refund calculation too.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: If the train arrives late, we will do our best to transfer passengers to a different date or to the 4 Hour Cruise that departs at 12:30pm.

operational_pain.finding: The refund and reschedule policy has four different clocks running at once, plus a per-person fee and a card fee. A front-line agent has to know which clock applies to which booking before quoting anything.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Cruise-only reservations are refundable up to 72 hours prior to your cruise departure. A 3% credit card processing fee will be retained for cancellations. [...] $15 per person re-booking fee [...] completely non-refundable and may not be used on any other sailings.
operational_pain.confidence: fact. Other clocks on the same page: hotel packages refundable 'until 7 days prior to the first day of your package reservation, within 7 days the package is non-refundable and non-changeable', and packages including 'motorcoach or train' are 'refundable until 21 days prior'. One free date change is allowed if made within 24 hours of departure, and the $15 per person fee applies to changes after that.

operational_pain.finding: Weather re-routes are a routine, captain-initiated event that produces a case-by-case partial refund on the cruise while the bundled hotel and transport stay non-refundable. Every one of those is a manual money decision and a manual customer conversation, and the exposure sits on the busiest days.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Our cruises go out rain or shine. We only cancel cruises due to unsafe sea conditions, in which case we will notify you as soon as possible.
operational_pain.confidence: fact. The refund side is on the policy page: cruises may be 'limited to the confines of Resurrection Bay', in which case partial refunds apply, while additional services 'remain non-refundable and non-changeable'. Decision authority sits with the Coast Guard-certified Captain.

operational_pain.finding: The complimentary Seward shuttle, which covers a long list of pickup points, can only be added by telephone with 24 hours notice, and it is excluded from the earliest cruise of the day.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Please call us to add the shuttle to your reservation at least 24 hours before your cruise for your convenience. [...] Advance reservations are required for shuttle pick-up. [...] Shuttle is not available for the 8:00 am 6 Hour Kenai Fjords National Park Cruise.

operational_pain.finding: Cruise ship day-callers have to be moved 0.6 to 0.8 miles from the terminal inside a 165-minute window, on a 15-minute headway, and that window closes before the 10:00 am departure.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: A complimentary Major Marine Tours shuttle will make continuous loops between Harbor 360 Hotel, the South Harbor office, and the Cruise Ship Terminal from 7:00 am. - 9:45 a.m., departing every 15 minutes.

operational_pain.finding: Every seat is manually assigned by staff before sailing, and special seating is explicitly not guaranteed. With eight vessels and up to seven departure slots a day at peak, that is a large recurring manual allocation job.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Seating arrangements are assigned by Major Marine Tours staff prior to the cruise. Special seating requests can be made, but we cannot guarantee requests until all seating arrangements are made.

operational_pain.finding: Dietary and accessibility requests are captured at the point of reservation and vary by vessel, so a booking change can silently break an accommodation. Wheelchair access differs vessel by vessel and three named boats have none.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Vegetarian guests on the 6 Hour Cruise, 7.5 Hour Cruise and 8.5 Hour Cruise can request a vegetarian sandwich in advance, at the time of reservation.
operational_pain.confidence: fact. Same page on access: accessible on the first deck inside cabin only for Glacier Express, Skana, Spirit of Adventure, Spirit of Matushka and Kenai Fjords 360, while 'The Viewfinder, Orca Song (8.5-hour cruise), and Rachel Marie (12:30pm 4-hour departure) are not wheelchair accessible' and 'None of our vessels can accommodate motorized wheelchairs.'

operational_pain.finding: They rebuild a large share of their Seward workforce from scratch every year, inside a three-month hiring window, and subsidise it with dorm beds and a completion-contingent travel payment.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: During our cruise season we employ about 60 seasonal employees in Seward. Our peak hiring time for seasonal positions is January 15th - April 15th.
operational_pain.confidence: fact. Same page: shared dormitory housing in Seward from '$15 per night, depending on location and based on double occupancy', housing 'not available in Anchorage', and out-of-state staff receive a '$400 travel reimbursement upon the completion of their contract'. Roles hired are 'Customer Service/Sales Staff, Deckhand and Senior Deckhand Crew, Engineering, Inventory/Dock Support, Cooks, and occasionally licensed Captains.' NOTE: any percentage-of-workforce figure is INFERENCE and loose, because year-round headcount is not published.

operational_pain.finding: Published operational detail has drifted out of sync across their own pages. NOTE FOR DOWNSTREAM: these are WEBSITE DEFECTS, not operating pain. Per OUTREACH_CRAFT they may never be the email's opening and must not be promoted to a headline finding.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: The morning departure of the 6 Hour Cruise is a new cruise option starting in 2021 [...] not available in 2020.
operational_pain.confidence: fact. The five: (1) that 2020/2021 sentence sits on a live 2026 booking page. (2) Parking is '$10 charge per vehicle per day' on the FAQ and 'Public parking in Seward is $15 for the day' on the check-in page. (3) The train arrives '11:15 a.m.' on the FAQ and 'Arrives Seward: 11:20 a.m.' on the transportation page. (4) The Orca Quest Cruise has a live 2026 product page but is absent from all-cruises. (5) Rachel Marie appears in the FAQ and has its own feedback page but is absent from the vessels page.

operational_pain.finding: The comparison tool a shopper needs most is published as a flat image rather than as text, so it is not readable by screen readers, not searchable, and not usable by an assistant answering which cruise should I take.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Compare our cruises quickly with our cruise comparison chart
operational_pain.confidence: fact that the chart is delivered as an embedded image with no text equivalent in the page body

operational_pain.finding: The booking engine is a third-party embed slow enough that they warn about it on the page.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Please allow several seconds for the booking engine to load below.
operational_pain.confidence: fact for the sentence. THIN on which vendor, the embed exposes no vendor domain to a text fetch. DO NOT GUESS THE VENDOR.

operational_pain.finding: Review generation is a manual, per-vessel funnel. They maintain ten separate guest-feedback pages, one per boat, each asking the guest to go post on Google Maps and TripAdvisor.
operational_pain.verbatim_quote: Thank you for cruising with Major Marine Tours! Please fill out the section below and let us know how your trip was.
operational_pain.confidence: fact. Per-vessel URLs listed in the page sitemap.

voice_of_customer.balance_statement: HONEST BALANCE, AND IT BINDS EVERYTHING DOWNSTREAM. The sentiment picture is overwhelmingly positive. 2,398 of 2,555 Google reviews are five stars, and only 61 of 2,555, about 2.4 percent, sit at three stars or below. Employee sentiment on Indeed is 4.5 from a thin sample of ten. Every verbatim review fetched was positive. NOT A SINGLE verbatim negative guest review could be surfaced from a fetched page, and that is a gap in this dossier rather than evidence that none exist. ANY PAIN CLAIM IN THE STUDY MUST REST ON THEIR OWN PUBLISHED POLICIES AND PROCESSES, WHICH ARE HARD FACT, NOT ON CUSTOMER COMPLAINTS, WHICH COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. Nothing downstream may imply guests complain.

timely_context.where_they_are_in_the_season: FACT. August 10th 2026 sits at the very top of their peak. Seven departure slots are running. The step-down is sharp and dated: the 10:00 am and 3:00 pm 4 Hour departures and the 8:00 am 6 Hour departure all end August 23rd, 2026.
timely_context.season_end_ladder_2026: FACT. 8.5 Hour Northwestern Fjord ends September 7th. 7.5 Hour Kenai Fjords ends September 13th. 6 Hour Kenai Fjords ends September 21st. 4 Hour Kenai Fjords Wildlife runs latest, to October 11th. https://majormarine.com/all-cruises/
timely_context.2027_already_selling: FACT. 10% off your 2027 cruise with promo code SAVE10, available for all 2027 tour dates, and the Spring Wildlife Cruise page already carries 2027 dates of March 20 - May 16.
timely_context.possible_stale_promo: INFERENCE, flagged. The repeat customer discount on the live specials page is written against 'customers who cruised in 2025', which reads like copy not rolled forward. Could be intentional. Do not assert it as an error.
timely_context.new_seward_cruise_terminal: FACT, and it directly reshapes their day-call market. Royal Caribbean Group and the Alaska Railroad opened the Dale R. and Carol Ann Lindsey Alaska Railroad Terminal in Seward, June 10 2026 dateline, '41,500 square feet of enclosed space and 27,000 square feet of open pass-through luggage transfer layout' https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/royal-caribbean-group-and-alaska-railroad-company-celebrate-official-opening-of-cruise-terminal-in-seward-alaska-302796837.html . A secondary trade report puts the build at approximately $137 million, names Ovation of the Seas as first ship to homeport there, and reports a 30-year usage agreement under which Royal Caribbean commits to 'a minimum of 140,000 guests to Seward annually during the Alaska cruise season' https://www.cruisehive.com/royal-caribbeans-new-seward-cruise-terminal-finally-opens/211277 . The City of Seward's own page still describes the project in future tense.
timely_context.why_that_matters_to_them: INFERENCE. Their published cruise-terminal shuttle runs 7:00 am to 9:45 am on a 15-minute headway to catch ship passengers before morning departures, so a bigger, busier terminal 0.6 miles away raises the volume flowing through that exact window. A plausible read, NOT a measured effect.
